title: Why the Way Children Think About Mathematics Matters
subject: Education & Learning
excerpt: A correct answer tells us something. How a child arrived at it can tell us much more. A reflection on multiplication, children’s strategies, and what we can learn when we stop to ask, “How did you get it?”
